[""] = "{\\u1}", [""] = "{\\u0}" } local function fail(message) error(message, 0) end local function round_ratio(n, d) return (2 * n + d) // (2 * d) end local function split_literal(text, separator) local result = {} local position = 1 while true do local ending = text:find(separator, position, true) if not ending then result[#result + 1] = text:sub(position) return result end result[#result + 1] = text:sub(position, ending - 1) position = ending + #separator end end local function copy_cues(cues) local copy = {} for i, cue in ipairs(cues) do local lines = {table.unpack(cue.lines)} copy[i] = {index = cue.index, start = cue.start, stop = cue.stop, lines = lines} end return copy end local function char_count(cue) local total = 0 for _, line in ipairs(cue.lines) do total = total + #line end return total end local function dialogue(cue) for _, line in ipairs(cue.lines) do if line:sub(1, 2) == "- " then return true end end return false end local function two_decimal(value) return string.format("%d.%02d", value // 100, value % 100) end local function trim_spaces(text) return text:match("^ *(.-) *$") end local function time_value(text) local h, m, s, ms = text:match("^(%d%d):(%d%d):(%d%d),(%d%d%d)$") if not h or tonumber(m) > 59 or tonumber(s) > 59 then fail("bad arguments") end return tonumber(h) * 3600000 + tonumber(m) * 60000 + tonumber(s) * 1000 + tonumber(ms) end local function time_text(t, kind) if kind == "ASS" then local c = (t + 5) // 10 return string.format("%d:%02d:%02d.%02d", c // 360000, (c // 6000) % 60, (c // 100) % 60, c % 100) end return string.format("%02d:%02d:%02d%s%03d", t // 3600000, (t // 60000) % 60, (t // 1000) % 60, kind == "VTT" and "." or ",", t % 1000) end local function unsigned_arg(text, low, high) if not text:match("^%d+$") or #text > 9 then fail("bad arguments") end local value = tonumber(text) if value < (low or 0) or value > (high or 999999999) then fail("bad arguments") end return value end local function typed_arg(text, kind) if kind == "string" then return text elseif kind == "time" then return time_value(text) elseif kind == "pos" then return unsigned_arg(text, 1) elseif kind == "signed" then local digits = text:match("^%-?(%d+)$") if not digits or #digits > 9 then fail("bad arguments") end return tonumber(text) elseif kind == "fps" then local parts = split_literal(text, "/") if #parts > 2 then fail("bad arguments") end return {unsigned_arg(parts[1], 1, 100000), #parts == 1 and 1 or unsigned_arg(parts[2], 1, 100000)} elseif kind == "text" or kind == "replace" then local parts = split_literal(text, "|") for _, part in ipairs(parts) do if part == "" then fail("bad arguments") end end if kind == "replace" and #parts ~= 2 then fail("bad arguments") end return parts end local low, high = kind:match("^(%d+):(%d+)$") return unsigned_arg(text, tonumber(low), tonumber(high)) end local function arguments(line, cues) local command = line:match("^[^ ]+") if schemas[command] == nil then fail("unknown command") end local args, kinds = {}, {} if command == "DELETE" then local parts = words(line) if #parts < 2 or #parts > 3 then fail("bad arguments") end for i = 2, #parts do args[#args + 1] = unsigned_arg(parts[i], 1) kinds[#kinds + 1] = "pos" end if #args == 2 and args[2] < args[1] then fail("bad arguments") end else kinds = words(schemas[command]) local position = #command + 2 local raw = {} for i = 1, #kinds do if position > #line then fail("bad arguments") end if i == #kinds and (kinds[i] == "string" or kinds[i] == "text" or kinds[i] == "replace") then raw[i] = line:sub(position) position = #line + 2 else local ending = line:find(" ", position, true) if ending then raw[i] = line:sub(position, ending - 1) position = ending + 1 else raw[i] = line:sub(position) position = #line + 2 end end end if position <= #line or (#kinds == 0 and #line ~= #command) then fail("bad arguments") end for i, kind in ipairs(kinds) do args[i] = typed_arg(raw[i], kind) end end for i, kind in ipairs(kinds) do local maximum = #cues + (command == "INSERT" and 1 or 0) if kind == "pos" and args[i] > maximum then fail("no cue " .. args[i]) end end if command == "SYNC" and cues[args[1]].start == cues[args[3]].start then fail("sync points coincide") end return command, args end local function wrap_lines(lines, width) local output = {} for _, word in ipairs(words(table.concat(lines, " "))) do if #output > 0 and #output[#output] + 1 + #word <= width then output[#output] = output[#output] .. " " .. word else output[#output + 1] = word end end return output end local function markup(line) local items = {} local p = 1 while p <= #line do local tag for text in pairs(format_tags) do if line:sub(p, p + #text - 1) == text then tag = text break end end local rest = line:sub(p) local ending = line:find(">", p + 5, true) if tag then items[#items + 1] = {"format", tag, 0} p = p + #tag elseif rest:sub(1, 7) == "" then items[#items + 1] = {"font", "", 0} p = p + 7 elseif rest:sub(1, 5) == "") and ending then items[#items + 1] = {"font", line:sub(p, ending), 0} p = ending + 1 elseif line:sub(p, p + 3) == "{\\an" and line:sub(p + 4, p + 4):match("^[1-9]$") and line:sub(p + 5, p + 5) == "}" then items[#items + 1] = {"position", line:sub(p, p + 5), tonumber(line:sub(p + 4, p + 4))} p = p + 6 else items[#items + 1] = {"ordinary", line:sub(p, p), 0} p = p + 1 end end return items end local function converted_line(line, mode) local output, tags, position = {}, 0, 0 local escapes = {["&"] = "&", ["<"] = "<", [">"] = ">"} for _, item in ipairs(markup(line)) do local kind, text, digit = table.unpack(item) if kind ~= "ordinary" then tags = tags + 1 end if kind == "position" and position == 0 then position = digit end if kind == "ordinary" then output[#output + 1] = mode == "VTT" and (escapes[text] or text) or text elseif mode == "VTT" and kind == "format" then output[#output + 1] = text elseif mode == "ASS" and kind == "format" then output[#output + 1] = format_tags[text] elseif mode == "ASS" and kind == "position" then output[#output + 1] = text end end local result = table.concat(output) if mode ~= "ASS" then result = trim_spaces(result) end return result, tags, position end local function clean_hi(line) local output, segments, p = {}, 0, 1 while p <= #line do local c = line:sub(p, p) local closing = ({["["] = "]", ["("] = ")"})[c] local ending = closing and line:find(closing, p + 1, true) if ending then segments = segments + 1 p = ending + 1 else output[#output + 1] = c p = p + 1 end end local function normalize(text) return trim_spaces((text:gsub(" +", " "))) end local result = normalize(table.concat(output)) local prefix = result:sub(1, 2) == "- " and "- " or "" local body = prefix == "" and result or result:sub(3) local label = body:match("^[A-Z][A-Z0-9 ]*:") if label then result = normalize(prefix .. body:sub(#label + 1)) end return result, segments, label and 1 or 0 end local function list_line(cue, p) return p .. " " .. cue.index .. " " .. time_text(cue.start) .. " " .. time_text(cue.stop) .. " " .. table.concat(cue.lines, "|") end local function inspect(command, args, cues) local output, n = {}, #cues if command == "LIST" or command == "AT" then for p, cue in ipairs(cues) do if command == "LIST" or (cue.start <= args[1] and args[1] < cue.stop) then output[#output + 1] = list_line(cue, p) end end if command == "AT" then output[#output + 1] = "AT active=" .. #output end elseif command == "VALIDATE" then for p, cue in ipairs(cues) do local d = cue.stop - cue.start if cue.index ~= p then output[#output + 1] = "cue " .. p .. ": index " .. cue.index .. " (expected " .. p .. ")" end if d <= 0 then output[#output + 1] = "cue " .. p .. ": end not after start" end if p > 1 and cue.start < cues[p - 1].stop then output[#output + 1] = "cue " .. p .. ": overlaps previous by " .. (cues[p - 1].stop - cue.start) .. " ms" end if d >= 1 and d < 700 then output[#output + 1] = "cue " .. p .. ": too short (" .. d .. " ms)" elseif d > 7000 then output[#output + 1] = "cue " .. p .. ": too long (" .. d .. " ms)" end for j, line in ipairs(cue.lines) do if #line > 42 then output[#output + 1] = "cue " .. p .. ": line " .. j .. " too long (" .. #line .. " chars)" end end if #cue.lines >= 3 then output[#output + 1] = "cue " .. p .. ": too many lines (" .. #cue.lines .. ")" end if d >= 1 and char_count(cue) * 1000 > 21 * d then output[#output + 1] = "cue " .. p .. ": too fast (" .. two_decimal((char_count(cue) * 100000) // d) .. " cps)" end end output[#output + 1] = "VALIDATE problems=" .. #output elseif command == "SEARCH" then for p, cue in ipairs(cues) do for _, line in ipairs(cue.lines) do if line:find(args[1], 1, true) then output[#output + 1] = p .. " " .. time_text(cue.start) .. " " .. line break end end end output[#output + 1] = "SEARCH found=" .. #output elseif command == "GAPS" then for p = 1, n - 1 do local gap = cues[p + 1].start - cues[p].stop if gap < args[1] then output[#output + 1] = p .. " " .. (p + 1) .. " " .. gap end end output[#output + 1] = "GAPS count=" .. #output elseif command == "STATS" then output[1] = "STATS cues=" .. n if n == 0 then return output end local durations, total, characters, longest = {}, 0, 0, 1 for i, cue in ipairs(cues) do durations[i] = math.max(0, cue.stop - cue.start) total = total + durations[i] if durations[i] > 0 then characters = characters + char_count(cue) end if durations[i] > durations[longest] then longest = i end end output[#output + 1] = "duration total=" .. time_text(total) .. " mean=" .. time_text(total // n) output[#output + 1] = total == 0 and "speed -" or "speed " .. two_decimal((characters * 100000) // total) output[#output + 1] = "longest cue=" .. longest .. " duration=" .. time_text(durations[longest]) if n == 1 then output[#output + 1] = "gap none" else local selected, best = 1, cues[2].start - cues[1].stop for p = 2, n - 1 do local gap = cues[p + 1].start - cues[p].stop if gap > best then selected, best = p, gap end end output[#output + 1] = "gap cue=" .. selected .. " ms=" .. best end elseif command == "PRINT" then for _, cue in ipairs(cues) do output[#output + 1] = tostring(cue.index) output[#output + 1] = time_text(cue.start) .. " --> " .. time_text(cue.stop) table.move(cue.lines,1,#cue.lines,#output+1,output) output[#output + 1] = "" end elseif command == "TOVTT" then output = {"WEBVTT", ""} for _, cue in ipairs(cues) do local lines, position = {}, 0 for _, line in ipairs(cue.lines) do local text, tags, digit = converted_line(line, "VTT") if position == 0 and digit > 0 then position = digit end if text ~= "" then lines[#lines + 1] = text end end if #lines > 0 then local settings = "" if position >= 7 then settings = " line:0" elseif position >= 4 then settings = " line:50%" end if position == 1 or position == 4 or position == 7 then settings = settings .. " align:start" elseif position == 3 or position == 6 or position == 9 then settings = settings .. " align:end" end output[#output + 1] = tostring(cue.index) output[#output + 1] = time_text(cue.start, "VTT") .. " --> " .. time_text(cue.stop, "VTT") .. settings table.move(lines,1,#lines,#output+1,output) output[#output + 1] = "" end end elseif command == "TOASS" then output = {"[Events]", "Format: Layer, Start, End, Style, Name, MarginL, MarginR, MarginV, Effect, Text"} for _, cue in ipairs(cues) do local lines = {} for j, line in ipairs(cue.lines) do lines[j] = converted_line(line, "ASS") end output[#output + 1] = "Dialogue: 0," .. time_text(cue.start, "ASS") .. "," .. time_text(cue.stop, "ASS") .. ",Default,,0,0,0,," .. table.concat(lines, "\\N") end elseif command == "FRAMES" then local a, b = table.unpack(args[1]) for p, cue in ipairs(cues) do output[#output + 1] = p .. " " .. ((cue.start * a) // (1000 * b)) .. " " .. ((cue.stop * a) // (1000 * b)) end end return output end local function modify(command, args, cues) local output, n = {}, #cues if command == "SHIFT" or command == "SHIFTFROM" or command == "SCALE" or command == "SYNC" or command == "SNAP" then local first = command == "SHIFTFROM" and args[1] or 1 local clamped, changed = 0, 0 local transform if command == "SYNC" then local p1, t1, p2, t2 = table.unpack(args) local s1 = cues[p1].start local den = cues[p2].start - s1 transform = function(t) local num = t1 * den + (t - s1) * (t2 - t1) if den < 0 then return round_ratio(-num, -den) end return round_ratio(num, den) end elseif command == "SCALE" then transform = function(t) return round_ratio(t * args[1], args[2]) end elseif command == "SNAP" then local a, b = table.unpack(args[1]) transform = function(t) return round_ratio(round_ratio(t * a, 1000 * b) * 1000 * b, a) end else local delta = command == "SHIFT" and args[1] or args[2] transform = function(t) return t + delta end end for p = first, n do local cue = cues[p] local start, stop = transform(cue.start), transform(cue.stop) if start < 0 or stop < 0 then clamped = clamped + 1 end start, stop = math.max(0, start), math.max(0, stop) if start ~= cue.start then changed = changed + 1 end if stop ~= cue.stop then changed = changed + 1 end cue.start, cue.stop = start, stop end if command == "SNAP" then output[1] = "SNAP changed=" .. changed elseif command == "SCALE" then output[1] = "SCALE cues=" .. n else output[1] = command .. " cues=" .. math.max(0, n - first + 1) .. " clamped=" .. clamped end elseif command == "FIXOVERLAP" then local fixed, failed = 0, 0 for p = 1, n - 1 do local candidate = cues[p + 1].start - args[1] if cues[p].stop > candidate then if candidate > cues[p].start then cues[p].stop = candidate fixed = fixed + 1 else output[#output + 1] = "cue " .. p .. ": cannot fix" failed = failed + 1 end end end output[#output + 1] = "FIXOVERLAP fixed=" .. fixed .. " failed=" .. failed elseif command == "EXTEND" then local extended, short = 0, 0 for p, cue in ipairs(cues) do if cue.stop - cue.start < args[1] then local candidate = cue.start + args[1] if p < n then candidate = math.min(candidate, cues[p + 1].start) end if candidate > cue.stop then cue.stop = candidate extended = extended + 1 end end if cue.stop - cue.start < args[1] then short = short + 1 end end output[1] = "EXTEND extended=" .. extended .. " short=" .. short elseif command == "TIME" then local p, start, stop = table.unpack(args) cues[p].start, cues[p].stop = start, stop output[1] = "TIME cue=" .. p elseif command == "SORT" then for p, cue in ipairs(cues) do cue.original = p end table.sort(cues, function(a, b) if a.start ~= b.start then return a.start < b.start elseif a.stop ~= b.stop then return a.stop < b.stop end return a.original < b.original end) local moved = 0 for p, cue in ipairs(cues) do if cue.original ~= p then moved = moved + 1 end cue.original = nil end output[1] = "SORT moved=" .. moved elseif command == "RENUMBER" then local changed = 0 for p, cue in ipairs(cues) do if cue.index ~= p then changed = changed + 1 end cue.index = p end output[1] = "RENUMBER changed=" .. changed elseif command == "MERGE" then local result, merged = {}, 0 for _, cue in ipairs(cues) do local previous = result[#result] local joined = false if previous and cue.start - previous.stop < args[1] and not dialogue(previous) and not dialogue(cue) then local lines = {table.unpack(previous.lines)} table.move(cue.lines,1,#cue.lines,#lines+1,lines) lines = wrap_lines(lines, 42) if #lines <= 2 then previous.stop = math.max(previous.stop, cue.stop) previous.lines = lines merged = merged + 1 joined = true end end if not joined then result[#result + 1] = cue end end cues = result output[1] = "MERGE merged=" .. merged .. " cues=" .. #cues elseif command == "SPLIT" then local result, split = {}, 0 for _, cue in ipairs(cues) do local duration = cue.stop - cue.start if duration <= 0 or dialogue(cue) then result[#result + 1] = cue else local lines = wrap_lines(cue.lines, args[1]) if #lines <= 2 then cue.lines = lines result[#result + 1] = cue else local parts, weights, allotted, order = {}, {}, {}, {} local total = 0 for i = 1, #lines, 2 do local part = {lines[i]} if lines[i + 1] then part[2] = lines[i + 1] end parts[#parts + 1] = part local weight = #part[1] + (part[2] and #part[2] or 0) weights[#weights + 1] = weight total = total + weight end local remaining = duration for i, weight in ipairs(weights) do allotted[i] = (duration * weight) // total remaining = remaining - allotted[i] order[i] = i end table.sort(order, function(a, b) local ra, rb = (duration * weights[a]) % total, (duration * weights[b]) % total if ra ~= rb then return ra > rb end return a < b end) for i = 1, remaining do allotted[order[i]] = allotted[order[i]] + 1 end local start = cue.start for i, part in ipairs(parts) do result[#result + 1] = {index = cue.index, start = start, stop = start + allotted[i], lines = part} start = start + allotted[i] end split = split + 1 end end end cues = result output[1] = "SPLIT split=" .. split .. " cues=" .. #cues elseif command == "INSERT" then local p, start, stop, lines = table.unpack(args) table.insert(cues, p, {index = p, start = start, stop = stop, lines = lines}) output[1] = "INSERT cue=" .. p .. " cues=" .. #cues elseif command == "DELETE" then local p, q = args[1], args[2] or args[1] for i = q, p, -1 do table.remove(cues, i) end output[1] = "DELETE removed=" .. (q - p + 1) .. " cues=" .. #cues elseif command == "TEXT" then local p, lines = table.unpack(args) cues[p].lines = lines output[1] = "TEXT cue=" .. p .. " lines=" .. #lines elseif command == "BALANCE" then local changed, skipped, dialogues = 0, 0, 0 for _, cue in ipairs(cues) do if dialogue(cue) then dialogues = dialogues + 1 else local cue_words = words(table.concat(cue.lines, " ")) local text = table.concat(cue_words, " ") local candidate, best_difference, best_first = nil, math.maxinteger, math.maxinteger if #text <= 42 then candidate = {text} else for j = 1, #cue_words - 1 do local left = table.concat(cue_words, " ", 1, j) local right = table.concat(cue_words, " ", j + 1) local difference = math.abs(#left - #right) if #left <= 42 and #right <= 42 and (difference < best_difference or (difference == best_difference and #left < best_first)) then candidate, best_difference, best_first = {left, right}, difference, #left end end end if not candidate then skipped = skipped + 1 else local different = #cue.lines ~= #candidate for i, line in ipairs(candidate) do if cue.lines[i] ~= line then different = true end end if different then changed = changed + 1 end cue.lines = candidate end end end output[1] = "BALANCE changed=" .. changed .. " skipped=" .. skipped .. " dialogue=" .. dialogues elseif command == "STRIP" or command == "CLEANHI" then local result, tags, labels, removed_lines, removed_cues = {}, 0, 0, 0, 0 for _, cue in ipairs(cues) do local lines = {} for _, line in ipairs(cue.lines) do local text, count, speakers if command == "STRIP" then text, count = converted_line(line, "STRIP") else text, count, speakers = clean_hi(line) labels = labels + speakers end tags = tags + count if text == "" or (command == "CLEANHI" and text == "-") then removed_lines = removed_lines + 1 else lines[#lines + 1] = text end end if #lines == 0 then removed_cues = removed_cues + 1 else cue.lines = lines result[#result + 1] = cue end end cues = result local prefix = command == "STRIP" and "STRIP tags=" .. tags or "CLEANHI segments=" .. tags .. " labels=" .. labels output[1] = prefix .. " removed_lines=" .. removed_lines .. " removed_cues=" .. removed_cues elseif command == "REPLACE" then local old, new = table.unpack(args[1]) local pattern = old:gsub("(%W)","%%%1") local replacements, changed = 0, 0 for _, cue in ipairs(cues) do local local_count = 0 for j, line in ipairs(cue.lines) do local count cue.lines[j],count = line:gsub(pattern,function() return new end) local_count = local_count+count end replacements = replacements + local_count if local_count > 0 then changed = changed + 1 end end output[1] = "REPLACE count=" .. replacements .. " cues=" .. changed end return cues, output end local function load_block(block, k, cues) if not block[1]:match("^%d+$") or #block[1] > 6 then return "BAD CUE " .. k .. ": index" end if not block[2] or #block[2] ~= 29 or block[2]:sub(13, 17) ~= " --> " then return "BAD CUE " .. k .. ": time" end local valid_start, start = pcall(time_value, block[2]:sub(1, 12)) local valid_stop, stop = pcall(time_value, block[2]:sub(18, 29)) if not valid_start or not valid_stop then return "BAD CUE " .. k .. ": time" end if #block < 3 then return "BAD CUE " .. k .. ": no text" end local lines = {table.unpack(block,3)} cues[#cues + 1] = {index = tonumber(block[1]), start = start, stop = stop, lines = lines} return nil end local cues, block, blocks, bad = {}, {}, 0, 0 while true do local line = io.read("l") if line == "" or line == "###" then if #block > 0 then blocks = blocks + 1 local problem = load_block(block, blocks, cues) if problem then io.write(problem, "\n") bad = bad + 1 end block = {} end if line == "###" then break end else block[#block + 1] = line end end io.write("LOAD cues=", #cues, " bad=", bad, "\n") local history = {} local function execute(line) local command, args = arguments(line, cues) if command == "UNDO" then if #history == 0 then fail("nothing to undo") end local previous = table.remove(history) cues = previous.cues return {"UNDO command=" .. previous.command} elseif modifying[command] then history[#history + 1] = {command = command, cues = copy_cues(cues)} local output cues, output = modify(command, args, cues) return output end return inspect(command, args, cues) end local count = tonumber(io.read("l")) for i = 1, count do local valid, output = pcall(execute, io.read("l")) if valid then for _, line in ipairs(output) do io.write(line, "\n") end else io.write("ERROR ", output, "\n") end end
